scope: Existing supervised collection-reward recovery regression after shared prize delivery extraction
build: Same packaged JAR as phase5 prizes

results.name: Only authorized operators open a frozen-payload preview; recipient and reason are disclosed without item delivery
Stale confirmation rechecks operator permission and recipient collection permission before every effect
Recipient disconnect invalidates an old recovery confirmation without altering its reservation
Pending recovery preserves the original plan/components/operation ID, delivers only to recipient once, and records operator/reason
Empty review can resume; any intent, acknowledged prefix or changed frozen payload refuses replay
Reload cannot substitute new reward data into an old confirmed recovery plan
Recovery preview cannot leak reward icons or create replacement operations
Native target inventory and original completed operation IDs survive restart without redelivery
Closed, uncertain, partial and changed operations remain blocked across restart; untouched reservation stays pending

limits: Uses existing explicit synthetic journal fixture and real native inventory/save/restart; not coverage of every external adapter.
